description: This is a Java test class for the QuickTextPagerView component in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying UI behavior, theme application, and interaction logic for the QuickTextPagerView.

classes.name: QuickTextPagerViewTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the QuickTextPagerView UI component in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, inflates the view, and sets theme values before each test.

methods.name: testSetupBottomPadding
methods.description: Verifies that the bottom padding of the quick text actions layout is set correctly.

methods.name: testShowMediaIcon
methods.description: Checks the visibility of the media insertion icon based on theme values.

methods.name: testShowClearEmojiOnlyOnHistory
methods.description: Tests the visibility of the emoji delete button depending on the current page in the ViewPager.

methods.name: testSetOnKeyboardActionListener
methods.description: Ensures that setting a keyboard action listener updates the UI components accordingly.

methods.name: testPassesOnlyEnabledAddOns
methods.description: Verifies that only enabled add-ons are reflected in the keyboard pager's adapter count.

methods.name: testSetThemeValues
methods.description: Checks that theme values are correctly applied to UI elements, including icons and background.
